name: PT. Bank Pembangunan Daerah Banten, Tbk
summary: PT. Bank Pembangunan Daerah Banten, Tbk provides various banking services in Indonesia. The company offers demand, savings, and time deposits, as well as current accounts; investment credit, working capital credit, and bank guarantees; business development credit and pension credit; and MSME loans. PT. Bank Pembangunan Daerah Banten, Tbk was formerly known as PT Bank Pundi Indonesia, Tbk and changed its name to PT. Bank Pembangunan Daerah Banten, Tbk in August 2016. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Serang, Indonesia. PT. Bank Pembangunan Daerah Banten, Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Banten Global Development.
